items.t: GTA VI Broke Every Record in 24 Hours, So Why Did Take-Two Shareholders Sell?
items.sum: Rockstar posted a record-shattering launch and a near-perfect review score, yet Take-Two investors headed for the exits. The real money behind this franchise sits somewhere the day-one sales figures never touch, and it has not even launched.
